description: This file defines data models related to a calendar, leave details, and astrology information for a calendar and astrology app.

classes.name: CalendarEvent
classes.description: Represents a calendar event such as a leave or holiday, including date, title, type, and optional description.

classes.name: EventType
classes.description: Enum class indicating the type of calendar event (LEAVE or HOLIDAY).

classes.name: Leave
classes.description: Contains details about a user's leave, including ID, date, title, type, and optional description.

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: Enum class indicating the type of leave (PERSONAL, SICK, or CASUAL).

classes.name: AstrologyDetails
classes.description: Holds astrology-related information for a specific date, including raasi, nakshatra, sunrise and sunset times, and optional special notes.
